comments.author: Natascha
comments.body:
If you are Spanish or Portuguese, its best to deliver Hardened Rosewood Platings to the Carib colony, Trujillo or Pernambuco.
You can obtain 12 PAs for 5 Platings with Oxford skill.
You just need to prepare for Coals because Rosewood Plating is sold there. I believe it is the most efficient for both nations players.

comments.body:
Some of you may think its tough to hop back and forth every time, but there is a much better, time-saving way.
Prepare a ship with durability 1, large ship will be better. Change to the ship and try to go aground, you will be incapaciated soon. After you check shipwreck command, enter the port. Then you come to able to deliver items again.
